ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team domain. e.g: `bullno1.cloudflareaccess.com`. Leave empty to use a password instead.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Application Audience (AUD) Tag of the Access application that protects the dashboard hostname, from the application overview in Zero Trust. Leave empty to use a password instead.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: A shared password for the dashboard, used only when the two Access values are empty. Generate one of at least 16 characters, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 24`.
